scorecard.rationale: The ALS safflower arm worsened on a composite that contains swallowing. The two singer safflower arms moved in opposite directions on reflux totals, with no separate swallowing item in any report. TRIHEP3 lists a distinct safflower cohort from the drug and training dysphagia trials. The ataxia swallowing estimate used an MCT comparator. The safflower oleogel panel spat out the samples, and the cold-pressed mouse diet measured immunity. No directional estimate transfers to cold-pressed safflower oil and Parkinson dysphagia. Item-level ALS and reflux results plus lead-specific body access remain open.
